svg.title: HEATCORDOBA graphical abstract
svg.desc: Satellite remote sensing data from ERA5-Land, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Landsat-8 and AQUA-MODIS feeds into three hazard analyses—urban heat island, Aedes aegypti activity, and water quality—combined with vulnerability mapping to produce urban risk maps for Córdoba, Argentina, published on a Web-GIS platform.

g.text: Heat wave impacts on urban population · Córdoba, Argentina · ESA Proposal
